findings.result: Six symbols, three tapes, one Boolean scratch and finite control. Every phase tests only the current tape symbol and performs bounded local work or one head move. The generic list representation and external Nat fuel are observations; no length/emptiness test, arithmetic shift, random-access index or unbounded arithmetic is a step.

The initial output has zero represented cells. Setup writes L; each control tick writes a zero; each data symbol writes its actual Boolean; writeRight writes R. Four-step scan induction and explicit marker rewind derive the complete final state rather than assuming endpoint, shape or head-return equality.

Trace.next requires a live source state. padding_exact builds 4 setup + (4d+1) control + (4n+1) copy + [2(d+n)+8] finish transitions. Their sum is 6(d+n)+14. trace_live forbids an earlier halt; final is halt, with d=n=0 giving 14. Nil alone need not end halted, but this theorem ends at the explicit halted final state.

Each generic head/write operation preserves or increases represented cells. step_cells proves this for all transitions; trace_storage combines monotonicity with the actual final footprint. Thus every prefix, including after halt, has at most 2(d+n)+6 represented cells. The bound counts source n+2, control d+2 and output d+n+2 at completion; it is an upper bound at earlier prefixes, not equality throughout. Output allocation d+n+2 is exact and includes both newly written markers.

All three heads return to L. The entire data and unary-control tapes are preserved. The output is overwritten fresh blank workspace, and scratch is cleared from arbitrary initial Bool, not restored. This is a forward padding/copy implementation, with no dirty-output/scratch inverse claim.

padded_eq_zeroShift joins the literal replicated zero prefix to the accepted recursive zeroShift. padding_value reuses zero_shift_value directly. signed_padding_value uses the supplied separate sign bit and widened low-word length; pow_add gives exact signed multiplication by 2^d. This does not implement sign-format construction.

The generic Tape.readHead/writeHead/moveRight/moveLeft are exact accepted f28dbd4d. Generalized Trace induction hypotheses require the continuation g or final-halt ht argument; the repair supplies these. The write record joins the same intended fields into valid layout. Removing a post-rw tactic follows a closed goal. Final scan_four normalizes both concrete Input cases then lets Trace.nil infer the equal complete state, replacing one underconstrained Input wildcard. Public statements, model, bounds, imports and probes are unchanged.
